one_line: Indo-Greek king of Bactria who pushed into northwestern India and styled himself ‘the Unconquered.’

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, athletic and tall with a seasoned soldier’s build
appearance.face: oval Greek face with straight nose, strong jaw, light olive complexion, short trimmed beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes with thick brows, default expression calm and confident with a slight half-smile
appearance.hair: wavy dark brown hair cut short to mid-neck, brushed back from the forehead with a few loose strands; on top he wears a white elephant-scalp headdress with a small stylised trunk resting over his left temple and the animal’s ears draped back over his head like a hood, secured by a narrow bronze headband
appearance.costume: over a knee-length white linen chiton with short sleeves, he wears a sleeveless, fitted Greek-style cuirass of bronze over padded leather, shaped but fully covered by a deep teal wool cloak (chlamys) fastened over his right shoulder with a circular bronze brooch; the chiton’s lower hem has a simple thin red woven border, and a dark red leather belt with bronze studs cinches his waist; below, he has sand-coloured woolen trousers (anaxyrides) tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with cross-lacing; around his neck hangs a small gold pendant with a simple circular design, and on his right wrist a plain bronze bracelet; the overall silhouette mixes Hellenistic military gear with Bactrian-Indian practicality while remaining modest and fully draped
appearance.signature: a long Hellenistic spear (dory) with a straight ash-wood shaft, iron spearhead, and bronze butt-spike, carried in his right hand or resting over one shoulder, often paired with a round bronze shield slung on his back bearing a faint engraved elephant motif

ref_desc: Demetrius I Aniketos is a mid-30s olive-skinned Greek king with a short beard, wavy dark brown hair, a white elephant-scalp headdress with bronze headband, wearing a bronze cuirass over white chiton, deep teal cloak, sand trousers, brown boots and carrying a long spear with a round bronze shield.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Demetrius I Aniketos: a tall, athletic Indo-Greek king in his mid-30s with an oval olive-toned face, straight nose, dark sharp eyes, short trimmed beard and wavy dark brown hair brushed back with a few loose strands. On his head sits a white elephant-scalp headdress, the small stylised trunk resting over his left temple and the ears draped back like a hood, held by a narrow bronze headband. He wears a knee-length white linen chiton with short sleeves and a thin red border at the hem, over which is a fitted bronze cuirass on padded leather; a deep teal wool cloak (chlamys) hangs from his right shoulder, fastened by a circular bronze brooch. A dark red leather belt with bronze studs encircles his waist, while sand-coloured woolen trousers are tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots with cross-lacing. Include a small gold circular pendant at his neck and a plain bronze bracelet on his right wrist. His signature weapon is a long ash-wood spear with iron head and bronze butt-spike held in his right hand or resting over one shoulder, and a round bronze shield with a faint engraved elephant motif strapped on his back. Use a palette dominated by deep teal, white, bronze, dark red, and brown leather, and present him from multiple angles to clearly show face, hair, costume details, and his spear and shield.
